belief_update: I know I'm not the same as the people who don't carry this kind of thing, but I don't know if that makes me any less than them. I think if people knew, they'd still treat me the same, but I don't know if I'd feel the same about myself. I keep it hidden because I don't want to be seen as broken, even though I know I'm not broken — just still trying to figure it out. Some days I feel like I'm holding it all together, other days I'm not sure how much is actually held back. I don't know if it's something I need to fix or just something I need to carry. I don't know if I'm worth being relied on, but I don't think I'm worth being ignored either.
